newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Yugo Feb construction works worth 115 mln dinars.
newsitem.headline: Yugo Feb construction works worth 115 mln dinars.

text.p: The Federal Statistics Office reported the following economic indicator details.
NOTES -- Cumulative number of workers in the January-February period was seven percent below the same two months last year.
Cumulative number of hours put in by workers dropped nine percent against the same period last year.

At the end of February, the value of concluded building contracts stood at 1.054 billion dinars, compared to 805.164 million in January. The data refer to contracted construction works to be carried out during year regardless of when the orders were made.
The data covers major construction companies accounting for around 80 percent of total annual value of construction works.
The number of workers excludes engineers and technicians. -- Amra Kevic, Belgrade newsroom +381 11 222 4305
